scene: Prologue: cultic inscriptions and first card clue
source: 滋孕万物 诞育<P_Yellow>圣骸</>
translation: All things are nurtured; the <P_Yellow>Sacred Remains</> are born.

scene: Prologue: cultic inscriptions and first card clue
source: 绯红<P_Yellow>神子</> 不灭之始
translation: The Crimson <P_Yellow>Divine Child</>: the dawn of immortality.

scene: Prologue: cultic inscriptions and first card clue
source: 噩梦？拒绝……逃离？像是在暗示什么？
translation: A nightmare? Rejection... escape? Is it hinting at something?

scene: Prologue: awakening and exploration
source: 好陌生的地方，我怎么什么都不记得了？
translation: This place feels so unfamiliar... Why can't I remember anything?

scene: Prologue: awakening and exploration
source: 红色的……月亮？呃……头好痛。
translation: A crimson... moon? Ugh... my head hurts.

scene: Prologue: awakening and exploration
source: 路被树干挡住了……不过看起来可以翻过去。
translation: A fallen tree is blocking the path... but it looks like I can climb over it.

scene: Prologue: Flower-Covered Altar and Objects of Prophecy
source: 羊皮纸上说，这里是“开满鲜花的祭坛”？
translation: The parchment says this is the 'Flower-Covered Altar'?

scene: Prologue: Flower-Covered Altar and Objects of Prophecy
source: 按照启示，要寻找三个“预言之物”……
translation: According to the revelation, I need to find three 'Objects of Prophecy'...

scene: Prologue: Flower-Covered Altar and Objects of Prophecy
source: “一物藏匿，羔羊归家之音……”，小羊玩偶？
translation: 'One object lies hidden—the sound of a lamb returning home...' A lamb doll?

scene: Prologue: Flower-Covered Altar and Objects of Prophecy
source: 三个圆形区域，对应三个“预言之物”？放上去试试。
translation: Three circular spaces—one for each of the three 'Objects of Prophecy'? I'll try placing them here.

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage1: girl and older brother
source: 哥哥！哥哥快看，树林里有一头小鹿！
translation: Brother! Brother, look! There's a little deer in the woods!

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage1: girl and older brother
source: 哇，它也在看我们！哥哥，这里太美了！
translation: Wow, it's looking at us too! Brother, this place is so beautiful!

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage1: girl and older brother
source: 怎么样？是不是很开心？
translation: Well? Are you having fun?

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage1: girl and older brother
source: 嗯！今天好开心，好久没出来玩了！
translation: Yes! I'm having so much fun today. I haven't been out to play in ages!

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage1: girl and older brother
source: 那你乖乖站在这里，哥哥给你准备了惊喜。
translation: Then be a good girl and stand right here. I have a surprise for you.

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage1: girl and older brother
source: “母亲”也会祝福你，给你最好的礼物。
translation: 'Mother' will bless you too, and give you the greatest gift of all.

scene: Prologue: aftermath of first residual memory
source: 果然有用。这些残留的画面，是小女孩和她的哥哥？
translation: It worked. Are these lingering visions of the little girl and her brother?

scene: Prologue: aftermath of first residual memory
source: 得去找第二个物品了，“一物收存，新生之种，葬于石像之旁……”？
translation: I need to find the second object. 'One object kept safe—the seed of rebirth, buried beside the stone statue...'

scene: Prologue: searching for the Objects of Prophecy
source: 怎么多了把斧头……也许能用上它。
translation: An axe? Where did that come from...? Maybe it will come in handy.

scene: Prologue: searching for the Objects of Prophecy
source: 箱子里什么也没有……再去其他地方找找。
translation: There's nothing in the chest... I'll look somewhere else.

scene: Prologue: searching for the Objects of Prophecy
source: “葬于石像之旁”……难道在石像旁边？过去看看。
translation: 'Buried beside the stone statue'... Could it be next to the statue? I should take a look.

scene: Prologue: Flower-Covered Altar and Objects of Prophecy
source: “新生之种”……这倒像是颗“种子”，放到祭坛上试试。
translation: 'Seed of rebirth'... This does look like a 'seed.' I'll try placing it on the altar.

scene: Prologue: Flower-Covered Altar and Objects of Prophecy
source: 嗯？祭坛里好像长出了什么东西……好奇怪。
translation: Hm? Something seems to be growing out of the altar... How strange.

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage2: girl and older brother
source: 哥哥，我一动也不能动吗？假如，我往左跳一小步呢？
translation: Brother, do I really have to stay perfectly still? What if I hop just one tiny step to the left?

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage2: girl and older brother
source: 乖，再等会儿，生日惊喜马上就要准备好了。
translation: Good girl. Wait a little longer—the birthday surprise is almost ready.

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage2: girl and older brother
source: ……哥、哥哥！木偶怎么……动了？！
translation: ...B-Brother! How is the puppet... moving?!

scene: Prologue: searching for the final Object of Prophecy
source: 还差最后一个物品，“一物隐蔽，绯红月辉照耀其上”？
translation: Only one object remains. 'One object lies hidden, bathed in crimson moonlight'?

scene: Prologue: searching for the final Object of Prophecy
source: 绯红月辉？难道是这张红月纸牌？用它试试。
translation: Crimson moonlight? Could it be this crimson moon card? I'll try it.

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage2: ritual
source: 哥哥告诉过你了，别动，仪式就要开始了。
translation: I told you, don't move. The ritual is about to begin.

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage2: ritual
source: 什么……仪式？我们不是来过生日的吗？
translation: What... ritual? Aren't we here to celebrate my birthday?

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage2: ritual
source: 生日？没错！今天，就是我们的<P_Yellow>新生之日</>！
translation: Birthday? That's right! Today is our <P_Yellow>day of rebirth</>!

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage2: ritual aftermath
source: 呃，他们不是幻影吗？怎么会这样……
translation: Wait, weren't they phantoms? How can this be...?

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage2: ritual
source: 哥哥，我听不懂……我害怕。
translation: Brother, I don't understand... I'm scared.

scene: Prologue cinematic PeterStage2: ritual aftermath
source: 唔……哥哥，你痛不痛……
translation: Mm... Brother, does it hurt...?

scene: Player-created name display
source: 银星奎林
translation: Silverstar Quirin

scene: Prologue: first Beyonder ability tutorial
source: 这是什么……好像有一股力量？
translation: What is this...? It feels like there's some kind of power.

scene: Prologue: first Beyonder ability tutorial
source: 一个尝试……试试吧，掌握非凡力量的感觉。
translation: A test... Let's try it and see what it feels like to wield Beyonder powers.

scene: Prologue: first Beyonder ability tutorial
source: 令人惊叹的能力，这就是非凡力量？
translation: What an incredible ability... Is this the power of a Beyonder?

scene: Prologue: first Beyonder ability tutorial
source: 不错，看来你已经适应和掌控了这股力量。
translation: Not bad. It seems you've already adapted to and gained control of this power.

scene: Prologue: cult ritual confrontation
source: 你们破坏了仪式，“伟大母亲”不会原谅你们的！
translation: You ruined the ritual! The 'Great Mother' will never forgive you!

scene: Prologue: first Beyonder combat tutorial
source: 尝试使用非凡能力，战胜这只污秽的怪物。
translation: Try using your Beyonder abilities to defeat this foul creature.

scene: Live server queue/status message
source: 马上就轮到了……
translation: It'll be our turn soon...

scene: Live event banner title
source: 全新探索地图上线
translation: A Brand-New Exploration Map Is Now Available

scene: Live event banner description
source: 前往狂暴海，登上传奇海盗船，开启大航海纪元
translation: Head to the Raging Sea, board a legendary pirate ship, and usher in the Age of Exploration.

scene: Live ambient NPC dialogue
source: 今天杰克把咖啡钱给老比尔了吗？
translation: Did Jack give Old Bill the coffee money today?

scene: Live ambient NPC dialogue
source: 最后一个，叫完下班回家。
translation: One last person. Once I've woken them up, I can clock off and go home.

scene: Live ambient NPC dialogue
source: 该起来工作了！
translation: Time to get up and work!

scene: Live ambient NPC dialogue
source: 起床上班了！
translation: Wake up! Time for work!

scene: Live ambient NPC dialogue
source: 太累了……
translation: I'm exhausted...

scene: Live ambient NPC dialogue
source: 有的人靠叫别人起床工作赚钱！嘿嘿！
translation: Some people make money by waking others up for work! Hehe!
